query:
SELECT
               product_id AS "product_id!",
               COUNT(*) AS "variant_count!",
               COALESCE(SUM(stock), 0)::BIGINT AS "total_stock!",
               COALESCE(MIN(stock_min), 0) AS "min_stock_min!"
           FROM product_variants
           WHERE product_id = ANY($1)
           GROUP BY product_id
